objective: Record and classify the full transition from normal/crowded conditions through capital-flow propagation, broad withdrawal, price damage and recovery without using future outcomes to rewrite earlier states.

source_roles.rule: Fugle intraday can create provisional price/liquidity/breadth warnings but cannot manufacture same-day formal institutional, margin or TDCC states. Formal EOD state requires canonical integrity PASS.

clock_separation.INTRADAY: Fugle price/volume/liquidity only; hourly or event-driven provisional warning; no formal flow state.
clock_separation.CLOSE_PRELIM: After market close; Fugle close/breadth plus any verified same-day institutional data if available; margin may remain pending.
clock_separation.EOD_FORMAL: Only after canonical PRICE+INSTITUTIONAL+MARGIN for the trade date pass freshness/hash/integrity gates.
clock_separation.OWNERSHIP_WEEKLY: Latest PIT-safe TDCC snapshot; never daily-forward-filled.
clock_separation.NEXT_DAY_RECONCILIATION: If source revisions or hash changes occur, append a reconciliation record; never overwrite the original black-box observation.

measurement_principles.allocation_wording_rule: Institutional buy/sell data directly evidence net flow, not AUM allocation weights. Use relative net flow unless holdings/exposure data independently confirm allocation change.
measurement_principles.aggregate_independence_rule: TotalNet is Foreign+Trust+Dealer aggregate and MUST NOT be counted as an independent institutional channel.

normalization.robust_z: (x - trailing_median) / (1.4826 * trailing_MAD); if MAD=0 use empirical rank only

research_event_band.note: Predeclared research thresholds only; any change requires a new version after cross-cycle evidence, never in-place retuning.

persistence.first_or_second_shot: condition true on at least 3 of last 5 eligible sessions
persistence.regime_confirmation: condition true on at least 4 of last 6 eligible sessions
persistence.recovery: recovery conditions true on at least 5 consecutive eligible sessions before de-escalation

regime_types.INTERNAL_ROTATION: One or more crowded/source industries show persistent relative outflow while other TWSE industries show verified positive absorption and broad market flow is not broadly negative.
regime_types.BROAD_RISK_OFF: Net-flow deterioration is broad across industries and primitive channels with weak/absent destination absorption, accompanied or followed by broad price/breadth deterioration.
regime_types.MIXED: Internal rotation and broad risk-off evidence overlap.
regime_types.UNRESOLVED: Evidence insufficient or clocks/data are incomplete.

state_machine.L1_VULNERABLE: At least two vulnerability/internal-structure families are unusually adverse, but no confirmed primitive-channel exit. This is NOT a sell signal.
state_machine.L2_FIRST_SHOT: At least one primitive institutional channel has a confirmed persistent adverse relative-net-flow event. TotalNet alone cannot create FIRST_SHOT.
state_machine.L3_SECOND_SHOT_PROPAGATION: FIRST_SHOT is active and either a different primitive channel independently confirms, or aggregate TotalNet confirms together with both FLOW_BREADTH and CAPITAL_MIGRATION confirmation. TotalNet may corroborate but may not double-count the first primitive channel.
state_machine.L4_REGIME_CONFIRMATION: SECOND_SHOT persists across the medium window; aggregate 10/20-session flow remains adverse, propagation breadth remains abnormal, and no verified flow re-entry/recovery invalidates it.
state_machine.L5_ABSOLUTE_WITHDRAWAL: REGIME_CONFIRMATION plus absolute withdrawal from the source industry or broad TWSE market. INTERNAL_ROTATION requires verified destination absorption; BROAD_RISK_OFF requires broad negative flow without sufficient destination absorption.
state_machine.L6_PRICE_DAMAGE: Prior withdrawal state plus broad price/breadth damage. This is late confirmation, not the desired first warning.
state_machine.REBOUND_WITHOUT_REENTRY: After L3+, price/breadth recover materially but primitive/aggregate flows do not independently re-enter; state memory remains elevated and cannot reset to NORMAL from price alone.
state_machine.RECOVERY: Flow re-entry and breadth/leadership recovery persist; de-escalation uses hysteresis and requires five consecutive eligible sessions.

escape_index.name: HENGCE_ESCAPE_PRESSURE
escape_index.construction: Equal-weight mean of valid family adverse scores; no data-driven weights until cross-cycle validation. Missing families are not imputed.
escape_index.velocity: 5-session change in HENGCE_ESCAPE_PRESSURE; acceleration is change of velocity.
escape_index.precision_warning: A numeric index cannot upgrade/downgrade the state by itself and has no trading authority.

before_any_formal_state: target date equals latest expected TWSE trading date
source hashes recorded in black-box record
freshness_and_integrity_gate.failure_policy: UNVERIFIED / FAIL_CLOSED; do not reuse previous day's value as if current.
